card.fires_on: Fires on a short piece just before a colon, percent sign, period or space, such as the 1 in a 1:1 ratio, the 0 in 120 or 20, and the first part of a name like NetBSD or Seyfert.

modes.label: Digit in ratios and numbers
modes.description: A leading digit in a ratio, percentage or round number, right before a colon, percent sign or following zero.
